historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: EPS 5yr CAGR (21.1%) is significantly higher than FCF 5yr CAGR (15.1%) and revenue 5yr CAGR (8.9%) due to the FY2020 EPS anomaly (RMB 2.80 EPS from one-off charges). EPS 3yr CAGR (16.4%) is 12.2pp above revenue 3yr CAGR (4.2%), reflecting margin expansion rather than a divergence warning — operating leverage is genuine given gaming gross margins expanding from ~54% (FY2022) to ~64% (FY2025). FCF 3yr CAGR (7.4%) selected as the most representative sustainable cash generation rate, positioned between revenue growth (4.2%) and EPS growth (16.4%). No divergence warning triggered as FCF-to-revenue difference is 3.2pp (well below 30pp threshold).
historical_growth.notes: CAGRs: Revenue 3yr = 2022-2025; 5yr = 2020-2025. EPS 5yr uses 2019-2025 (6-year) to avoid FY2020 one-off anomaly. FCF and Equity 3yr = 2022-2025; 5yr = 2020-2025. Balance sheet equity uses FY year-end values.

base.rationale: Base case assumes moderate revenue acceleration from FY2025 levels driven by Marvel Rivals live-service maturation (40M+ players, 2026 Avengers content roadmap), Where Winds Meet console expansion (Xbox/Game Pass launch June 2026, 80M+ cumulative players), Blizzard partnership record revenue, and Destiny: Rising global traction. FCF margin held at 43% (consistent with FY2025 actuals of 43.2%), as operating leverage on higher gaming gross margins (69.4% total company, 74.8% gaming in Q1 2026) is offset by continued R&D investment (~15.7% of revenue). WACC 11% reflects Chinese tech risk premium for regulatory and geopolitical risks. Growth decelerates toward 4.5% in Year 5 as gaming market matures and non-gaming segments continue declining. Revenue growth from 8.5% (Y1) reflects slightly above current 6.1% Q1 2026 pace due to upcoming title releases and international expansion.

bull.rationale: Bull case: Marvel Rivals achieves $1.5B+ annual revenue and sustains 40M+ players through 2026 Avengers film seasonal campaign, Nintendo Switch 2 version in development. Where Winds Meet Xbox/Game Pass launch drives Western user growth with strong conversion to in-game purchase. AI-powered cost efficiencies push gaming gross margins above 76% and total FCF margin to 45%. Favorable NPPA environment (2,300+ licenses forecast in 2026) enables rapid new title monetization. International revenue reaches 35%+ of gaming mix by FY2028. Blizzard titles sustain record revenue. WACC reduced to 10% reflecting de-risked execution, persistent HKEX dual-listing discount compression, and continued $5B buyback program.

bear.rationale: Bear case: Chinese regulatory crackdown resumes (repeat of Dec 2023 draft-rule crash). Marvel Rivals player retention deteriorates under competition from Overwatch 2 and Valorant. International studio closures continue with pipeline gaps. Non-gaming segments (Cloud Music, Innovative Businesses) continue structural decline. Macro consumer weakness compresses in-game spending. Marketing spend spikes (Q4 2025 pattern) erode FCF margins to 38%. Q4 2025 sequential earnings decline (Non-GAAP NI: RMB 7.1B vs Q3's RMB 9.5B) seen as harbinger. US-China geopolitical escalation risks ADR delisting and institutional investor outflows. WACC elevated to 13% for regulatory tail risk and geopolitical premium.

base.notes: Intrinsic value converted to HKD at RMB:HKD = 1.08. Equity value = EV minus net_debt (which is negative, so adds net cash of RMB 39,859.7M). Upside calculated from current HKD 180.90.

bull.notes: Bull case assumes successful international expansion, AI-driven margin expansion, and sustained Marvel Rivals monetization.

bear.notes: Bear case reflects regulatory crackdown resumption and international expansion failure. Even in bear case, net cash of RMB 39.9B supports floor valuation.

base.notes: Entry price to achieve 15% CAGR to terminal value per share. Current HKD 180.90 is 25.6% above the 15%-CAGR entry price, suggesting the stock is priced for lower than 15% forward returns in the base case. Not a margin-of-safety entry at current price.

sensitivity.notes: Sensitivity matrix uses base case growth rate assumptions [8.5, 7.5, 6.5, 5.5, 4.5]% with FCF margin 43%. Rows = WACC (9%-13%), Columns = terminal growth (2.0%-4.0%). Current HKD price of 180.90 falls below all matrix values, confirming undervaluation across most WACC/terminal growth combinations. Only at WACC 13%+ with terminal growth 2% does the intrinsic value approach current price.

probability_weighted.notes: Weighted toward base case (60%) given moderate growth trajectory and elevated China-specific risks. 20% bull weight reflects genuine upside from Marvel Rivals global franchise potential and Where Winds Meet console expansion. 20% bear weight reflects non-trivial tail risk from Chinese regulatory reversals and US-China geopolitical escalation.

per_ads_valuation.notes: ADS IV assumes RMB:USD = 7.20. NTES trading at USD 117.64 vs base IV $166.85 implies 41.8% upside. At $117.64, NTES is priced at an implied P/E of ~11.2x (GAAP) on FY2025 earnings — well below the 15.9x implied by the HKD price, suggesting the ADR trades at a discount to the HK share (ADS at 117.64 = 117.64*7.2/5 = HKD 169.40 equivalent ordinary share price vs HKD 180.90 actual — consistent directional difference).

sanity_check.result: PASS — All current-price multiples within reasonable bounds for a profitable, net-cash Chinese gaming company growing FCF at ~7% annually. P/E of 15.9x and EV/FCF of 10.2x are undemanding given: (1) 43.2% FCF margin; (2) RMB 39.9B net cash = 8.3% of market cap; (3) active $5B buyback program; (4) growing international revenue from Marvel Rivals and Where Winds Meet. Base-case IV implies 22.8x P/E and 15.8x P/FCF, which are reasonable for the projected growth trajectory. No assumptions were auto-corrected.
sanity_check.notes: Sanity check compared current-price implied multiples against NetEase's own trading history (17-28x P/E range, 2021-2024) and comparable companies (Tencent 24-26x P/E, gaming sector 15-25x EV/EBITDA). Current multiples of 15.9x P/E and 13.0x EV/EBITDA represent the lower end of the historical range, consistent with the stock trading below its prior intrinsic value estimate of HKD 228.63 (January 2026 model). The stock has declined approximately 12.4% from the prior model's current price (HKD 206.60 to 180.90) without a corresponding deterioration in fundamentals — FY2025 FCF of 48,687 was above the prior model's 45,095 base.

valuation_philosophy: Intrinsic value estimated via a 5-year discounted cash flow model using free cash flow as the primary metric, consistent with NetEase's asset-light, high-FCF-conversion gaming business model (FY2025 FCF margin: 43.2%). Terminal value calculated using the Gordon Growth Model (perpetuity growth formula). WACC incorporates a China-specific regulatory and geopolitical risk premium of ~2-3pp above a US-equivalent discount rate. The net cash position (RMB 39.9B at March 31, 2026) is added back to enterprise value rather than treated as an earnings contributor, providing a conservative floor. Shares outstanding are 3,200M ordinary shares (640M ADS); the CSV SharesOutstanding column is not used as it erroneously mirrors GameRevenue data. All cash flows are modeled in RMB millions and converted to HKD (x1.08) and USD (x1/7.20) for reference.

current_valuation_metrics.notes: At HKD 180.90. Market cap HKD = 180.90 * 3,200M shares. RMB conversion at 1.08. USD at 7.20.

key_value_drivers: Marvel Rivals global franchise: 40M+ players, full 2026 Avengers content roadmap, Nintendo Switch 2 version in development; multiple-year live-service revenue stream
Where Winds Meet platform expansion: 80M+ cumulative players, Xbox/Game Pass launch June 2026 with 'Hidden Mountain' expansion, Imperial Palace DLC May 2026
Net cash fortress: RMB 39.9B ($5.5B) net cash position as of March 31 2026; generates ~RMB 3.95B annual interest income; funds $5B buyback ($2.9B remaining) and dividends
Gross margin expansion: Q1 2026 gaming gross margin ~74.8%, total company ~69.4% — up materially from ~54% in FY2022 — driven by self-developed title mix and lower platform revenue-sharing
AI development advantage: Comprehensive AI integration across full game development cycle driving production efficiency and content cadence; described as 'foundational competency' by CEO William Ding
Regulatory tailwind: NPPA approved 1,771 games in FY2025 (up 25% YoY), pace of 2,300+ forecast for 2026 — most permissive environment since 2021-2022 crackdown
key_risks: Gaming regulatory unpredictability: Dec 2023 draft rule crashed stock 28% in one session; government retains broad discretionary power; ~75% China revenue concentration amplifies any shock
US-China geopolitical escalation: HFCAA enforcement revival, ADR delisting risk, IP partnership restrictions (Marvel, Bungie) — partially mitigated by HKEX dual listing

International execution: Prior Western studio closures (Ouka, Jar of Sparks, Fantastic Pixel Castle, Bad Brain) show persistent management challenges; pipeline beyond Marvel Rivals and Where Winds Meet unproven
Live-service competition: Marvel Rivals faces well-resourced rivals (Overwatch 2, Valorant, Apex Legends); sustaining 40M+ players over multiple years is a high bar
Non-gaming structural decline: Cloud Music (RMB 7.8B FY2025, -2.5% YoY), Innovative Businesses (RMB 6.8B, -16% YoY) — 18% of revenue tracking lower
Q4 earnings volatility: Non-GAAP NI fell to RMB 7.1B in Q4 2025 from RMB 9.5B in Q3 2025 due to marketing cost spikes; earnings lumpy around major launches
valuation_summary.investment_recommendation: NetEase appears materially undervalued at HKD 180.90 (USD 117.64 ADS). Base case intrinsic value of HKD 259.49 (USD 166.85/ADS) implies 43.4% upside for HK shares and 41.8% for NTES ADR. Probability-weighted IV of HKD 257.91 confirms material undervaluation. The stock has declined ~12.4% since the prior January 2026 model (HKD 206.60) despite FY2025 FCF of RMB 48.7B exceeding the prior model's starting FCF of RMB 45.1B. Current multiples of 15.9x P/E and 10.2x EV/FCF represent the low end of NetEase's historical range and are undemanding for a business generating 43%+ FCF margins with a growing net cash position. Entry price for 15% CAGR to terminal value is HKD 144.05, so current price of HKD 180.90 does not offer a 15%-CAGR entry point in the base case — but given the 43.4% upside and fortress balance sheet, current prices appear to offer attractive risk-adjusted returns for a 3-5 year holding period. Bear case downside is limited (~10%) given the RMB 39.9B net cash floor.
